conclusion.text: All sides report a tanker striking a docked cruise ship in New Orleans that then overturned. West-bloc centre and right outlets lead with the $1m lawsuit, the right adds the tanker's navigational history, the left leads with video; East outlets focus on survival and nationality. No direct contradictions appear.
